title: Design system
description: The venture's design system, in the marketing package at marketing/design-system.json: the ethos read from the strategic foundation, and every brand choice (color, type, shape, motion, imagery, voice) with why it was made and the records it comes from. The values themselves live in marketing/brand.json; this record says why, so a choice can be revisited when the mission, the ICPs or the market change. Inputs are inherited from other functions through marketing/design-system/inputs, never copied. An agent's write is a draft a person accepts (experience-design).

brand.description: The brand record that holds the token values

ethos.description: What the venture stands for, in a sentence or two, as the design system reads it

traits.description: A few adjectives the brand should feel like, such as calm, exact, warm

avoid.description: What the brand should never feel like

audiences.description: The ICP profiles the design speaks to, by id, primary first

choice.description: What was chosen, such as a deep ink blue primary, or a humanist sans for body

tokens.description: The marketing/brand.json paths it sets, such as colors.primary or fonts.body

why.description: The reason, in terms of the ethos, the ICPs or the market

components.description: The components the venture's artifacts are built from, each with the tokens it uses

reads.description: Records whose content the component shows, such as foundation/problem

artifact.description: Where the design system is shown, such as a Claude Design System artifact URL

from.description: The inputs the choice rests on, by key from marketing/design-system/inputs: mission, problem, icp:<id>, alignment:<id>, market:<product>, founder:<id>, competitor:<name>
